alternatives: Hide tool calls behind a debug toggle
choice: Agent tool calls (Write, Read, Edit, Bash, WebSearch) are first-class visible trace attached to assistant turns, with summary-first progressive disclosure to full detail; stub fixtures cover running, succeeded, failed, and empty states.
rationale: Base prompt explicitly requires visible tool calls; transparency is the differentiator over generic chatbots and the basis of user trust.
Summary-first disclosure keeps the reading instrument calm while preserving auditability.
risks: Over-verbose traces could overwhelm the central column; information-tier discipline is required in surface architecture.
revisitWhen: Streaming/error-state evidence demands a revised trace model.
